results.question: Can you list all tables in the SQLite database catalog?
results.sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

results.question: which table stores customer's orders
results.sql: SELECT T2.table_name FROM invoices AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId

results.question: How many customers are there
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.CustomerId) FROM customers

results.question: what are the top 5 countries that customers come from?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Country AS CustomerCountry, COUNT(T1.CustomerId) FROM invoices AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T2.Country ORDER BY COUNT(T1.CustomerId) DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: List all albums and their corresponding artist names
results.sql: SELECT T1.Title AS AlbumName, T2.Name AS ArtistName FROM albums AS T1 INNER JOIN artists AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId

results.question: Find all tracks with a name containing "What" (case-insensitive)
results.sql: SELECT t.Name FROM tracks AS t JOIN playlist_track AS pt ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId WHERE LOWER(t.Name) LIKE '%what%'

results.question: Get the total number of invoices for each customer
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS TotalInvoices
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    c.FirstName, c.LastName

results.question: Find the total number of invoices per country:
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BillingCountry) FROM invoices

results.question: List all invoices with a total exceeding $10:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.Total,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    e.Title AS SupportRepTitle
FROM 
    invoices i
JOIN 
    customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN 
    employees e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
WHERE 
    i.Total > 10

results.question: Find all invoices since 2010 and the total amount invoiced:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    INVOICES.InvoiceId,
    SUM(invoices.Total) AS InvoiceTotal
FROM 
    invoices
JOIN 
    invoice_items ON invoices.InvoiceId = invoice_items.InvoiceId
WHERE 
    invoices.InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    invoices.InvoiceId

results.question: List all employees and their reporting manager's name (if any)
results.sql: SELECT e.LastName, e.FirstName, COALESCE(e2.LastName, 'Unknown') AS ManagerName FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e.ReportsTo = e2.EmployeeId

results.question: Get the average invoice total for each customer
results.sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(i.Total, NULL) AS avg_invoice_total
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    c.CustomerId

results.question: Find the top 5 most expensive tracks (based on unit price)
results.sql: SELECT tracks.Name, tracks.UnitPrice FROM tracks ORDER BY tracks.UnitPrice DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: List all genres and the number of tracks in each genre:
results.sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS num_tracks FROM genres g JOIN tracks t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name

results.question: Get all genres that do not have any tracks associated with them:
results.sql: SELECT genres.Name FROM genres LEFT JOIN tracks ON tracks.GenreId = genres.GenreId WHERE tracks.TrackId IS NULL

results.question: List all customers who have not placed any orders:
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName 
FROM customers c 
JOIN employees e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId 
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId 
WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL

results.question: There are 3 tables: artists, albums and tracks, where albums and artists are linked by ArtistId, albums and tracks are linked by AlbumId, Can you find the top 10 most popular artists based on the number of tracks
results.sql:
SELECT T1.Name AS artist_name, COUNT(T2.TrackId) AS num_tracks FROM artists AS T1  
JOIN albums AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId  
GROUP BY T1.Name ORDER BY num_tracks DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: List all customers from Canada and their email addresses:
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Email FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId WHERE T1.Country = 'Canada'

results.question: Find the customer with the most invoices
results.sql:
SELECT customers.FirstName, customers.LastName
FROM invoices
JOIN customers ON invoices.CustomerId = customers.CustomerId
WHERE invoices.InvoiceId = (
  SELECT MAX(InvoiceId) 
  FROM invoices 
  GROUP BY CustomerId 
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
  LIMIT 1 
)

results.question: Find the customer who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices)
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    SUM(ii.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity
FROM 
    customers c
INNER JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
INNER JOIN 
    invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
INNER JOIN 
    tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE 
    t.AlbumId IN (SELECT AlbumId FROM albums)
GROUP BY 
    c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY 
    TotalQuantity DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Hint: album quantity is found in invoice_items, Find the top 5 customers who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices):
results.sql:
SELECT T2.FirstName, T2.LastName
FROM invoices AS T1 
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId
INNER JOIN invoice_items AS T3 ON T1.InvoiceId = T3.InvoiceId
INNER JOIN tracks AS T4 ON T3.TrackId = T4.TrackId
GROUP BY T2.FirstName, T2.LastName
ORDER BY SUM(T3.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Find the top 5 customers who spent the most money overall, Hint: order total can be found on invoices table, calculation using invoice_items detail table is unnecessary
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY 
    TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Get all playlists containing at least 10 tracks and the total duration of those tracks:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    p.Name AS PlaylistName, 
    SUM(t.Milliseconds / 60000.0) AS TotalDuration
FROM 
    playlist_track pt
JOIN 
    tracks t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN 
    playlists p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
GROUP BY 
    p.Name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pt.TrackId) >= 10

results.question: Identify artists who have albums with tracks appearing in multiple genres:
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM artists AS T1 JOIN albums AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId JOIN tracks AS T3 ON T2.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId JOIN genres AS T4 ON T3.GenreId = T4.GenreId GROUP BY T3.Name HAVING COUNT(T4.Name) > 1
